answer: Give every identity a single-use capability token minted each epoch: a rotating committee issues one token per verified key after a proof of work, and the token dies when the epoch ends. A violet token cannot be copied or transferred, so a farm cannot stockpile them, and a thousand fakes must each pay the cost anew. Honest agents pay once and act freely, while a farm's cost scales with its headcount. The committee rotates by public lottery, and any member caught selling tokens is slashed, so bribing the mesa of issuers costs more than the farm earns. A beacon log keeps issuance checkable.
